## BigDecimal

Operands of *digits* decimal digits at working *precision*, so that
precision grows with the operands. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter. `round` drops the
low half of the operand; `parse` builds the value from its string.

Verified this run: decimo and libmpdec produce the same
2000-digit product from the same 1000-digit operands.

| Digits / precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | | CPython `decimal` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| 9 / 28 | subtract | 11.2 ns | 29.6 ns | **2.66× faster** | 47.2 ns | **4.23× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | multiply | 7.8 ns | 25.9 ns | **3.32× faster** | 45.2 ns | **5.79× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | divide | 39.3 ns | 50.4 ns | **1.28× faster** | 68.7 ns | **1.75× faster** |
| 9 / 28 | round | 7.5 ns | 30.9 ns | **4.13× faster** | 69.3 ns | **9.26× faster** |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen. `2.3456789`, and
`** 1.5` for power. 100 000 digits is left out because `mpd_exp`
needs 82 seconds there and `mpd_ln` 239 seconds.

| Precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 600.0 ns | 854.3 ns | **1.42× faster** |
| 28 | exp | 1.78 µs | 4.45 µs | **2.50× faster** |
| 28 | ln | 1.94 µs | 12.76 µs | **6.57× faster** |
| 28 | power | 8.35 µs | 34.84 µs | **4.17× faster** |

| 100 | exp | 8.31 µs | 14.62 µs | **1.76× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 73.90 µs | 38.46 µs | 1.92× slower |
| 100 | power | 94.15 µs | 80.02 µs | 1.18× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 42.19 µs | 215.76 µs | **5.11× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 387.00 µs | 4.47 ms | **11.54× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 3.07 ms | 5.55 ms | **1.81× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.55 ms | 11.24 ms | **3.17× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 1.22 ms | 23.26 ms | **19.03× faster** |

| 10,000 | ln | 266.77 ms | 3.225 s | **12.09× faster** |
| 10,000 | power | 329.15 ms | 4.641 s | **14.10× faster** |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.
Division is 2n-by-n; two operands of the same width would give a
one-digit quotient and measure nothing.

| Digits | Operation | decimo | CPython `int` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | add | 40.3 ns | 25.2 ns | 1.60× slower |
| 100 | multiply | 85.2 ns | 118.6 ns | **1.39× faster** |
| 100 | floor divide | 406.1 ns | 295.7 ns | 1.37× slower |
| 100 | sqrt | 512.0 ns | 318.9 ns | 1.61× slower |
| 1,000 | add | 53.0 ns | 91.1 ns | **1.72× faster** |
| 1,000 | multiply | 1.16 µs | 5.60 µs | **4.84× faster** |
| 1,000 | floor divide | 8.53 µs | 12.73 µs | **1.49× faster** |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 4.26 µs | 4.52 µs | **1.06× faster** |
| 10,000 | add | 300.0 ns | 873.1 ns | **2.91× faster** |
| 10,000 | multiply | 54.24 µs | 267.12 µs | **4.92× faster** |
| 10,000 | floor divide | 169.07 µs | 554.27 µs | **3.28× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 104.64 µs | 271.11 µs | **2.59× faster** |
| 100,000 | add | 2.40 µs | 7.51 µs | **3.13× faster** |
| 100,000 | multiply | 1.18 ms | 8.87 ms | **7.55× faster** |
| 100,000 | floor divide | 4.68 ms | 18.27 ms | **3.91× faster** |
| 100,000 | sqrt | 2.64 ms | 8.49 ms | **3.21× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | add | 26.50 µs | 82.62 µs | **3.12× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | multiply | 23.75 ms | 374.61 ms | **15.77× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | floor divide | 118.17 ms | 753.91 ms | **6.38× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | sqrt | 69.35 ms | 344.44 ms | **4.97× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 8.51 µs | 50.58 µs | 43.88 µs | 32.00 µs |
| 1,000 | 67.16 µs | 104.38 µs | 72.17 µs | 164.67 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.27 ms | 884.92 µs | 702.75 µs | 6.01 ms |
| 100,000 | 34.92 ms | 15.46 ms | 23.07 ms | 186.53 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 822.31 ms | 267.04 ms | 419.74 ms | 8.545 s |
